cards.title: Button
cards.text: Triggers an action.

cards.title: Checkbox
cards.text: An on-off choice in a list or form.

cards.title: Field
cards.text: A label, control, hint and error laid out together.

cards.title: Form
cards.text: Form state and validation wired to fields.

cards.title: Input
cards.text: Single-line text entry.

cards.title: Input group
cards.text: An input with addons such as icons or buttons.

cards.title: Label
cards.text: The name of a form control.

cards.title: Native select
cards.text: The browser select, styled.

cards.title: Radio group
cards.text: One choice from a short list.

cards.title: Select
cards.text: One choice from a list, in a menu.

cards.title: Switch
cards.text: An on-off setting that applies at once.

cards.title: Chart
cards.text: Bars, lines and areas built on Recharts.

cards.title: Table
cards.text: Rows and columns of records.

cards.title: Alert
cards.text: A message that stays on the page.

cards.title: Badge
cards.text: A short label for a status or count.

cards.title: Empty
cards.text: What to show when there is nothing yet.

cards.title: Skeleton
cards.text: A placeholder while content loads.

cards.title: Spinner
cards.text: A small loading indicator.

cards.title: Toast
cards.text: A short message that confirms an action and goes away.

cards.title: Breadcrumb
cards.text: The path to the current page.

cards.title: Dropdown menu
cards.text: A menu of actions opened from a button.

cards.title: Navigation menu
cards.text: Site navigation with links and panels.

cards.title: Pagination
cards.text: Moves between pages of results.

cards.title: Tabs
cards.text: Switches between views of the same thing.

cards.title: Alert dialog
cards.text: A dialog that asks to confirm an action that cannot be undone.

cards.title: Dialog
cards.text: A window over the page for a focused task.

cards.title: Sheet
cards.text: A panel that slides in from an edge.

cards.title: Card
cards.text: A bordered container for one item or group.

cards.title: Collapsible
cards.text: One section that opens and closes.

cards.title: Item
cards.text: A row with media, title, description and actions.

cards.title: Scroll area
cards.text: A region with styled scrollbars.

cards.title: Separator
cards.text: A line between groups.

cards.title: Accordion
cards.text: Stacked sections that open one at a time.

cards.title: Aspect ratio
cards.text: Keeps an image or video at a fixed shape.

cards.title: Avatar
cards.text: A small image or initials for a person.

cards.title: Carousel
cards.text: Slides that move left and right.

cards.title: Attachment
cards.text: A file attached to a message.

cards.title: Bubble
cards.text: A chat message bubble.

cards.title: Button group
cards.text: Related buttons joined as one control.

cards.title: Calendar
cards.text: A month grid for picking dates.

cards.title: Combobox
cards.text: A text field with a filtered list of choices.

cards.title: Command
cards.text: A search-first menu of actions, opened from the keyboard.

cards.title: Context menu
cards.text: A menu on right-click.

cards.title: Data table
cards.text: Many records in one view: search, faceted filters, sorting, column choice, row selection with bulk actions, pagination and a density switch. Wraps TanStack Table, after shadcn's Data Table guide.

cards.title: Date picker
cards.text: A button that opens a calendar, for one date or a range. Built on calendar and popover, after shadcn's Date Picker.

cards.title: Drawer
cards.text: A panel that slides up from the bottom, for phones.

cards.title: Hover card
cards.text: A preview card on hover.

cards.title: Input otp
cards.text: Separate boxes for a one-time code.

cards.title: Kbd
cards.text: A keyboard key or shortcut.

cards.title: Marker
cards.text: A divider or status line inside a conversation.

cards.title: Menubar
cards.text: A row of menus, as in desktop apps.

cards.title: Message
cards.text: One message with its author and time.

cards.title: Message scroller
cards.text: A scrolling list of messages that keeps the newest in view.

cards.title: Popover
cards.text: Rich content in a floating panel, opened by click.

cards.title: Progress
cards.text: How far a task has come.

cards.title: Resizable
cards.text: Panels the user can resize by dragging.

cards.title: Sidebar
cards.text: The side navigation of an app.

cards.title: Slider
cards.text: A value picked by dragging along a track.

cards.title: Textarea
cards.text: Multi-line text entry.

cards.title: Toggle
cards.text: A button that stays pressed or not.

cards.title: Toggle group
cards.text: A set of toggles where one or many stay pressed.

cards.title: Tooltip
cards.text: A short hint on hover or focus.
